title: Smiling Mother and Son Outdoors, 1950s Deckled Edge Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription:
Freda and Billy.
Good of both.
description: A charming mid-1950s black-and-white outdoor portrait capturing a smiling woman (identified on the back as Freda) and a young boy (Billy) seated side-by-side on a garden bench. Freda wears an elegant mid-century tiered summer dress featuring a dramatic wide white collar or cowl neckline, while Billy is dressed in a classic gingham/checkered short-sleeve collared shirt with rolled-cuff trousers. In the background stands a rustic stone wall flanked by evergreen foliage and a large decorative stone garden urn. The print is framed by vintage deckled/scalloped edges.
